summary: Entrywise; vectors orthogonal to X are determined, for h, by their middle parts.

steps.claim: Entrywise at (i, j): the e*-coordinates of the columns t_i and γ⁻¹t_i vanish, and so do those of t'_j and γ'⁻¹t'_j (isotropicFramePair_mulVec_eq_zero_iff).
steps.lean:
ext i j; obtain ⟨⟩ := isotropicFramePair_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.1 congr($hᵀ i),
    isotropicFramePair_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.1 congr($h'ᵀ j)

steps.claim: The (i, j) entry, written as hermitian products of the middle parts.
steps.lean: show star (_ *ᵥ _) ᵥ* _ ⬝ᵥ _ *ᵥ _ = a * _ ᵥ* _ ⬝ᵥ _ - c * star (t · i) ᵥ* _ ⬝ᵥ _ *ᵥ _
steps.typed_fact: star (_ *ᵥ _) ᵥ* _ ⬝ᵥ _ *ᵥ _ = a * _ ᵥ* _ ⬝ᵥ _ - c * star (t · i) ᵥ* _ ⬝ᵥ _ *ᵥ _

steps.claim: For vectors with zero e*-parts, h is T on the middle parts; and h(γ⁻¹t_i, γ'⁻¹t'_j) = h(t_i, γγ'⁻¹t'_j) (γ⁻¹ is unitary). So the entry is a·h(t_i, t'_j) − c·h(t_i, γγ'⁻¹t'_j).
steps.lean:
simp_all [↓← dotProduct_mulVec, ↓← U.form_mulVec_mulVec γ⁻¹ (t · i), ↓splitGram_mulVec,
    fromBlocks_mulVec, neg_mulVec, dotProduct, mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]; grind
